user.title: Connect to a GivEnergy device
user.description: Enter the IP of the inverter dongle, AIO or Gateway. The integration probes it and works out the model and which registers it answers. Stop GivTCP for this device first — the dongle only serves one client at a time.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open a TCP connection. Check the IP and that port 8899 is reachable.
error.no_response: Connected, but the device didn't answer any register reads. Another client (GivTCP?) may be holding the connection.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This device is already configured (IP updated if it changed).

data.slow_every: Read settings registers every N polls

probe_registers.name: Probe registers
probe_registers.description: Sweep every known register range on the device and report which answer. Results appear as a notification and in the service response.

config_entry.name: Device
config_entry.description: GivEnergy Gateway Modbus Coms entry to probe.

device_address.name: Device address
device_address.description: Modbus device address (17 = inverter 0x11, 50-55 = batteries). Defaults to the probed address.

write_register.name: Write register
write_register.description: Write one holding register. Only registers that the integration already exposes as controls are allowed.
